summary: ITER 193 frontend-only test PASS. All 5 flows + regression verified on mobile viewport (390×844) as super@test.com. FLOW 1 (/admin/ad-programs → AdMaker Bids): New-bid modal opens → BMP app chip selectable → typing 'Freemium' into 'Option being promoted' surfaces suggestion pills (FREEMIUM, AFFILIATION, AIKIDO, AUCTION, BARTER, CASH MACHINE, CROSS SELLING, CROWD-FUNDING, CROWD-SOURCING) → advertiser 'UI Test Ads' + bid ₹5 → Create bid → card shows 'UI Test Ads → FREEMIUM' with LIVE/ACTIVE badge, ₹5.00/click max, 🌍 global, 0 impr / 0 clicks / ₹0.00 spent. Pause → badge flips to PAUSED, Edit → prefill 5, change to 6 → Save changes → card shows ₹6.00. Delete → 'Delete bid?' confirm dialog with Cancel + Delete → 'No bids yet.'. FLOW 2 (AdTaker Publishers): New publisher name 'UI Test Publisher' + site https://example.com + share 68 → 'Publisher created — Tracker ID: DZ-PUB-XXXXXXXX' alert; publisher card shows the tracker (copyable). Snippet button (small purple 'code-slash' action, y≈534) opens 'Embed snippet · {name}' modal with app chips + Copy button and the exact snippet `<script src="https://modal-responsive-fix.preview.emergentagent.com/api/adtaker/widget.js?tracker=DZ-PUB-<id>&app=bmp-55-patterns"></script>`. Stats expands amber box 'Last 30 days · 👁 0 👆 0 (0% CTR) ✅ 0 ≈ ₹0.00 earned'. Delete cleans it. FLOW 3 (Cutoffs & Slots): Global card shows Min Cutoff % (60) + Sponsored slots (3); changed to 58/3 → 'Saved — Global Sponsored defaults updated.' alert; restored to 60/3. Per-node overrides: searched 'Sleep Health', tapped row → editor shows 'Sleep Health (cn_hlt_sleep_health) · Effective: 60% cutoff (Global default) · 3 slots (Global default)'; set Min Cutoff 70 → Save → node row shows purple OVERRIDE badge and editor shows 'Effective: 70% cutoff (Node: Sleep Health)'; cleared field to blank → Save → override removed, back to Global default. FLOW 4 (/admin/decider-store): (a) 'Finder & Landing' tool opens settings modal — new '📣 Sponsored Solutions (global defaults)' section renders with Min Cutoff % + Sponsored slots (N) inputs prefilled from admin config; save works without error. (b) Each template card has a purple 'Catalog' action → opens 'Map to Central Catalog' modal with 'Search nodes…' input + L0/L1/L2/L3 catalog rows + 'Clear mapping' button; tapping 'Physical, Mental & Emotional Health' turns the card action into purple 'Catalog ✓' (with checkmark); reopen + Clear mapping → back to 'Catalog'. FLOW 5 (E2E sponsored): POSTed a ₹7/click bid on BMP 'Freemium' via /api/admaker/bids, cloned BMP full-app → /finder/{id} → tapped Run Finder → 'Top 5 matches' organic card first (Barter · Crowd-Funding · Crowd-Sourcing · Customer Loyalty · Digita-tion all @ 100%), then a separate amber 'Sponsored Solutions · AD' card BELOW with copy 'Promoted picks that also cleared your 60%+ quality cutoff. They never change the organic ranking above.' + row 'FREEMIUM · Promoted by E2E Ads · <description>'. Tapping the sponsored row fires the click beacon and does not error/navigate away. REGRESSION: /decider-store public storefront still renders 'Decider Apps · Finders' section (with FINDER badge on The 55 Business Model Patterns) + 'Decision Templates' section header (currently 0 templates → 'No decision templates in this view yet.'). Finder run on a fresh clone with NO bids shows the Top N organic card and NO 'Sponsored Solutions' card, confirming the section only renders when eligible live bids exist. All bids/decisions created during the test were deleted and global cutoff restored to 60/3.

issues: Small action buttons (Snippet/Stats/Edit/Pause/Delete/Activate) are ~14px tall in the row — below the 44pt mobile touch-target guideline. They are still tappable and fire onPress correctly, but consider bumping paddingVertical from 7 to 10-12 for better mobile ergonomics.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Selectors that work: 'text=New bid', 'text=Create bid', 'text=Pause', 'text=Delete' (last locator for confirm), 'text=Save global defaults', 'text=Save node override', 'text=New publisher', 'text=/Create & mint tracker/i', 'text=Finder & Landing', 'text=Clear mapping', 'text=Run Finder'. GOTCHAS: (1) The 'Snippet' text appears TWICE in the DOM (once inside a large parent card, once inside the small action button) — must use JS tree-walk to find the smaller (~44×14 box) clickable element via 'cursor:pointer' ancestor. (2) Same for 'Catalog' — the small purple action button is ~296×588 box on mobile, not the outer card. (3) Node rows in Cutoffs and Catalog list expose L0/L1/L2/L3 label prefix so 'text=Sleep Health' works reliably. (4) In the Finder screen, 'text=Run Finder' selector matches both the button and possibly a heading — click via JS-walk for reliability. (5) All admin flows require session cookie from /admin/login (super@test.com / SuperPass2026!) — API calls with credentials:'include' inherit it. Widget script URL format: https://<host>/api/adtaker/widget.js?tracker=DZ-PUB-<hex>&app=<template_id>. E2E bid payload: {template_id:'bmp-55-patterns', option_name:'Freemium', advertiser_name:'…', bid_paise:700, region:'global'}.
rca_of_issue: N/A — no defects found. Two transient test-instrumentation observations: (a) plain 'text=Snippet' / 'text=Catalog' locators can hit the wider ancestor container and generate a no-op click — solved by JS-walk to the touchable ancestor; (b) after Save on the global cutoff modal, the previously entered value can persist across tests (58) if the restore step is skipped — I restored to 60/3 explicitly at the end of Flow 5.
